selection: All98statuscompared loci with identical projected letters in VT andZL; no glyph preference or OCR output used
mandatory: Boundary at same offset in both editions, neither marked comma; period and drawing separators count as certain
optional: Union of all other annotated boundary offsets; optional bits independent for a deliberately broad stress family, not equiprobable or certified readings
primary_near_similarity: 1 iff both token lengths>=3 and Levenshtein distance<=1, else0
primary_locus_score: Remove first/last tokens. For M>=2 interiors, adjacent_hits/(M-1) minus all_ordered_distinct_index_pair_hits/(M*(M-1)); M<2=>0. Exact fractions; whole corpus=sum, equal locus weight.
cost: Number of optional cut decisions differing from VT; no paleographic probability
fragility: Minimum cost giving whole-corpus score<=0; radius0 if baseline<=0; null if impossible in family

randomization.method: Permute only interior tokens; first,last and within-locus multiset fixed for each segmentation. Shared pseudorandom priorities SHA256(seed|replica|locusID|token_start_offset), sorted lexicographically.
randomization.reported_tails: (1+count(nonnegative difference))/(B+1); VT baseline and envelope M_b=sum_l max_localpath(T_perm-T_obs). Envelope bounds every fixed segmentation tail in this coupled finite simulation; not a universal p-value or proof of historical mechanism.

calibration.ambiguous: One extra optional inside-token cut at halfway of token index7 in each even-indexed locus
calibration.gate: Positive copy_clean and copy_ambiguous envelope tails<=0.05; matched-shuffled baseline tails>0.05. Four examples do not estimate population power or TypeI error; if gate fails, real scores still archived but mechanism interpretation inconclusive.

known_non_identifiability: Near-edit statistic invariant under bijective character substitution; cannot recover key or meaning
Symmetric neighbor similarity invariant under reversing whole locus; cannot determine reading direction
scope: Descriptive development on already used pages. Tests fixed local-exchangeability diagnostic only; no whole-family rejection of copy/language/cipher
